extraction_method: Dried head sample (1.5 g), methanol/water 80:20; homogenized 11,000 rpm, stirred 1 h, centrifuged 18,500 rpm at 4°C, filtered 0.20 μm; triplicate extraction
sample_size: 3 replicate plots per irrigation treatment; five marketable heads per plot per collection; three collection dates per growing season; Table 3 gives treatment marginal means by head class
source_title: Effects of the Irrigation with Treated Wastewaters on the Proximate Composition, Mineral, and Polyphenolic Profile of the Globe Artichoke Heads [Cynara cardunculus (L.)]
database_reference: Table 3, TW treatment, processing head class; 400.1 ± 10.8 mg/100 g DW (mean ± SE)
extraction_notes: Table 3 value 400.1 ± 10.8 mg/100 g DW (mean ± SE); normalized mean to 4001.0 mg/kg DW ×10. Treatment abbreviations: FW freshwater; SW secondary-treated wastewater; TW tertiary-treated wastewater. Head classes retained separately. Promoted as a source-reported quantitative estimate. Exact positional standards support analyte identity; concentrations were calculated with 5-CQA response reference, not analyte-specific calibration. Table 3 provides treatment marginal mean ± SE by head class; the stored value is that reported mean, not an individual sample.
uncertainty_notes: Irrigation × growing-season interaction reported as nonsignificant; Table 3 reports marginal treatment means, not raw plot-level data. Standard error retained here. Triplicate extraction does not mean n=3 biological replicates. Wastewater-irrigated experimental crop context; held pending calibrated-value and food-scope review plus Stage B checksum. Calibration is a 5-CQA surrogate; absolute bias versus analyte-specific calibration is unknown. Results are treatment marginal means on dry matter, not sample-level observations. Keep values scoped to experimental artichoke heads and do not imply fresh-weight concentrations.
